content:
Updated, 7:04 PM Hong Kong Time: All user and developer-facing issues except for Xcode Cloud have been marked as resolved. We will continue monitoring the remaining issue. The original report follows.

Apple's system status page confirms that users and developers are currently experiencing issues with some services. Details below.

Multiple Apple services currently unavailable to some users

According to Apple's system status page, some users are experiencing issues with services including Find My, Game Center, Photos, and iWork for iCloud,

Below are Apple's descriptions for each affected service. We will continue updating this list as more services are impacted:

Find My – Issue Today, 3:30 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing Some users affected This service may be slow or unavailable.
Game Center – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Users are experiencing issues with Game Center. We are investigating and will update the status as more information becomes available.
iCloud Calendar – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
iWork for iCloud – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
iCloud Contacts – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
iCloud Mail – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
iCloud Web Apps (iCloud.com) – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
Photos – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.
iCloud Account and Sign In – Issue Today, 3:33 PM Hong Kong Time – Ongoing All users affected Some users may be experiencing issues with this service.

Additionally, Apple's developer system status page shows that Xcode Cloud began experiencing an outage at 3:59 PM Hong Kong Time. Apple said some users are "experiencing issues with this service" and added that the company is "working to resolve the issue." Apple News API and News Publisher are also experiencing issues.

Although Apple's system status page clearly states that these issues are not affecting all users, reports of iCloud and Find My outages on Downdetector have continued to increase over the past hour.

We will continue monitoring the situation and update this report when Apple releases more information or when these systems fully恢复運作.
